blurb: Guests can enjoy wine tastings, attend various events including concerts, yoga, and food pairings, and rent the venue for private parties or weddings. The vineyard produces small-batch, hand-crafted wines from locally grown grapes. They also offer a wine club with exclusive perks and access to special reserves.
